charter: this log establishes sensitivity and incorporation bias on the defects it captures; it cannot establish specificity or negative predictive value, because the true defect population is unbounded.
note: Seeded by hand. The three defect lines below were all found by review, not by a guard; that is the point of seeding with them.

symptom: A fact can be present in the page and still be wrong, or absent and still pass: facts.mjs asserts by containment in textContent.
root_cause: Containment is not a claim about meaning or placement. A fact inside an inert script element still enters textContent, and a uniquely occurring number sitting beside the wrong claim satisfies the check. 11 of 129 facts end in a digit; 16 are under 12 characters, so short facts collide readily.
source_of_truth: Hazzard 8e, the chapter each fact was taken from.
note: Word boundary and uniqueness are a partial repair only. Each entry needs to say what it denotes and where it belongs before global uniqueness can be enforced.

symptom: A CAUGHT verdict does not establish that the named guard fired. A mutation can be certified by a different guard reddening, and a needle can match two or more distinct labels, or none.
root_cause: mutants-classify.mjs certifies by substring: lines.some(l => l.startsWith("FAIL") && l.includes(needle)). Identity is never checked, only presence of text in some failing line.
note: The --static needle check cannot catch this: it asks whether SOME label contains the needle, which is true in both failure modes. Two MISSED results on main (shards 1/10 and 4/10) are the same defect seen from the other side.

symptom: A caption could be attached to the wrong table, or a table left uncaptioned, while the gate reported none.
root_cause: audit.mjs counted .tscroll elements and subtracted the count of .cap elements. Nothing tied a table to its own caption, so moving a caption onto the wrong table left the difference at zero, and a surplus caption drove it negative where the n>0 test is false. Both counts stayed mutually consistent at 113 while neither was ever checked against ground truth.
source_of_truth: the app itself: each caption is inserted as the immediately preceding sibling of its table (insertBefore(cap, el)) and read back by that adjacency.
note: Now tested in both directions by sibling adjacency: a table with no caption of its own, and a caption belonging to no table.
